computer_science.title: Computer Science & AI Pop Quiz
computer_science.department: School of Computer Science & Information Sciences

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
questions.explanation: Binary search trees divide the search space in half at each step, yielding O(log N) time on balanced trees.

questions.question: Which data structure follows the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: Queues process elements in the order they arrive (FIFO).

questions.question: In Python, which built-in function returns the number of items in a list or string?
questions.explanation: The len() function returns the length/size of collections in Python.

questions.question: What does HTTP stand for in web network communications?
questions.explanation: HTTP stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol, the foundation of data communication on the World Wide Web.

questions.question: Which neural network layer is most widely used for image recognition & computer vision?
questions.explanation: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) use spatial filters to extract image features effectively.

questions.question: What are the classic '4 Ps' of the Marketing Mix?
questions.explanation: Product, Price, Place, and Promotion form the fundamental pillars of traditional marketing strategy.

questions.question: In financial analysis, what does ROI stand for?
questions.explanation: Return on Investment (ROI) evaluates the efficiency or profitability of an investment.

questions.question: What does the 'S' in SWOT analysis represent?
questions.explanation: SWOT stands for Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats.

questions.question: Which management concept focuses on continuous incremental improvement in processes?
questions.explanation: Kaizen is a Japanese philosophy focusing on continuous improvement throughout all aspects of an organization.

questions.question: What is the break-even point in business economics?
options: When maximum possible revenue is earned
When total revenue equals total costs (zero profit/loss)
When taxes are paid in full
When stock prices hit a record high
questions.explanation: The break-even point is the sales volume where total revenues equal total expenses.

campus_heritage.title: UoH Campus Heritage & Trivia
campus_heritage.department: Indira Gandhi Memorial Library & Campus Archives

questions.question: In what year was the University of Hyderabad (UoH / HCU) established?
questions.explanation: The University of Hyderabad was founded in 1974 as a premier Central University.

questions.question: What famous balancing rock formation on campus is a protected national geological monument?
questions.explanation: Mushroom Rock is a famous natural balancing granite boulder protected for its geological rarity.

questions.question: Which scenic natural water body is located right in the heart of the central campus?
questions.explanation: Gundla Kunta is the iconic central lake of UoH, loved for serene walks and bird watching.

questions.question: What is the name of the main central library on campus?
questions.explanation: The Indira Gandhi Memorial Library (IGML) houses over 400,000 volumes.

questions.question: What popular student cultural festival is celebrated with music and theatre across the campus?
questions.explanation: Sukoon is the beloved annual cultural festival celebrated with grandeur across the Open Air Theatre and campus grounds.
